description: Basic principles of rocket propulsion and rocket engines.

lessons.description: A brief history of rocketry and space exploration.

lessons.name: Rocket Engine Types
lessons.description: Overview of different types of rocket engines.

name: Fuel and Combustion
description: Understanding rocket fuel, combustion processes, and efficiency.

lessons.name: Rocket Fuel
lessons.description: Overview of different types of rocket fuels.

description: Principles of rocket nozzle design and performance optimization.

lessons.name: Nozzle Design
lessons.description: Overview of different types of rocket nozzles.

lessons.name: Nozzle Optimization
lessons.description: Optimizing nozzle design for specific applications.

description: Basic aerodynamic concepts and fluid dynamics principles.

name: Subsonic and Supersonic Flow
description: Understanding subsonic and supersonic aerodynamic behaviors.

name: Aerodynamic Heating
description: Study of aerodynamic heating and thermal protection systems.

name: Spacecraft Structural Design
description: Fundamentals of designing spacecraft structures and materials selection.

name: Orbital Mechanics
description: Understanding orbital dynamics and mission planning.

name: Spacecraft Systems Engineering
description: Overview of spacecraft systems and subsystems engineering.

name: Organic Reaction Mechanisms
description: Covers step-by-step mechanisms in organic reactions including SN1, SN2, E1, and E2.

name: Functional Group Analysis
description: Explores structure, reactivity, and synthesis of major functional groups in organic molecules.

name: Spectroscopy of Organic Compounds
description: Introduction to NMR, IR, and mass spectrometry for organic compound identification.

name: Periodic Trends and Bonding
description: Discusses atomic structure, periodic properties, and types of chemical bonding in inorganics.

name: Coordination Chemistry
description: Studies ligands, complex ions, and geometry in coordination compounds.

name: Descriptive Inorganic Chemistry
description: Explores the behavior and reactions of main group and transition metal compounds.

name: Thermodynamics in Chemistry
description: Focuses on the laws of thermodynamics and their application in chemical systems.

name: Chemical Kinetics
description: Covers reaction rates, rate laws, and the influence of temperature and catalysts.

name: Quantum Chemistry
description: Explains wave-particle duality and atomic orbitals using quantum mechanical models.

name: Elvish Grammar and Vocabulary
description: Introduction to Elvish sentence structure and key vocabulary in Sindarin and Quenya.

name: History of Middle-earth Languages
description: Traces the evolution of Elvish, Dwarvish, and Mannish tongues through the ages.

name: Writing Systems and Scripts
description: Studies Tengwar and Cirth alphabets with translation exercises and calligraphy.

name: Diplomatic Relations of the Second Age
description: Explores political alliances and treaties among Elves, Men, and Dwarves.

name: War and Peace in Middle-earth
description: Analyzes key conflicts and peace processes in Tolkien's legendarium.

name: Leadership and Strategy
description: Examines figures like Elrond, Galadriel, and Aragorn in terms of leadership styles.
